comparisons.interpretation: Descriptive current-snapshot diagnostic; not a backtest, forecast-approval result, or alpha estimate.

comparisons.feature_label: EU27 total tourism nights trailing 3-month YoY
comparisons.definition: EU27 nights at tourist accommodation establishments; trailing-three-month sum versus prior year.
comparisons.interpretation: Descriptive current-snapshot diagnostic; not a backtest, forecast-approval result, or alpha estimate.

comparisons.feature_label: Equal-weight U.S. airport + EU platform-nights composite
comparisons.definition: Simple 50/50 average of the U.S. SFO activity feature and the EU27 platform-night feature; never row weighted.
comparisons.interpretation: Descriptive current-snapshot diagnostic; not a backtest, forecast-approval result, or alpha estimate.

comparisons.feature_label: Revenue-weighted U.S. airport + EMEA-proxy platform-nights composite
comparisons.definition: Point-in-time U.S./EMEA revenue weights from the latest available Airbnb 10-K, normalized within the two covered sleeves; EU27 platform nights proxy EMEA activity.
comparisons.interpretation: Descriptive current-snapshot diagnostic; not a backtest, forecast-approval result, or alpha estimate.

comparisons.feature_label: EU platform-night growth minus total-tourism growth
comparisons.definition: EU27 platform-night YoY less EU27 total-tourism-night YoY.
comparisons.interpretation: Descriptive current-snapshot diagnostic; not a backtest, forecast-approval result, or alpha estimate.
